text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was in the middle of going over race 
strategies with Cheval Grand in the 
trainer's office, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand stared blankly into space, 
looking completely lost in thought.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... we're talking about going fishing, 
right? I definitely prefer sea fishing...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
When I close my eyes like this... my 
heart... flies away... aboard a ship...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
A calm sea... a sprawling horizon... Just 
lazily dangling a fishing line...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand seems to have built up quite 
a bit of fatigue from running in 
consecutive races. We might need to 
reconsider her upcoming schedule.
